video_title: My Recovery Update, DJing Journey | Time Out with Tyrese Haliburton | Episode 2

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on his physical recovery and return to basketball
quotes.excerpt: I feel so good. I'm playing five-on-five, doing hard workouts every day. I'm back at this point.
quotes.quote: This week is week 52. This is my one year. I feel so good. I'm playing five-on-five, doing hard workouts every day. I could pretty much say I'm back at this point. I feel like I'm in shape, but there's a difference between being in shape and being in game shape. I feel like I took a different thing. I like to play fast, so I got to get back to there, which will take some time.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton reflects on the physical toll of his injury
quotes.excerpt: It's funny because I go back and I can watch old footage and my face is so swollen.
quotes.quote: It's funny because I go back and I can watch old footage and my face is so swollen from all those meds and my eyebrow is gone in a lot of pictures and videos. Just remembering what was the hurt from it and there's nothing that I'll ever remember more in my life than going up that plane with one leg, being helped down the plane with one leg, crying the whole night. It's surreal it's been a year, but I am so thankful it's beyond me, it's past me.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on using video games as a mental escape
quotes.excerpt: Video games are big for me because during my game day, I like to get away.
quotes.quote: Most importantly, it's a mental release. For me in season, video games are big for me because during my game day, I like to get away, go play video games with my boys, just be away from basketball for a little bit before getting to war. So I'm trying to get my mind off, especially this year, I got to get my mind off of this injury and this season.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton and DJ Bandcamp discuss DJing technical skills
quotes.excerpt: I would just get myself range to get down there.

text_blocks.speaker: DJ Bandcamp
text_blocks.text: So this is at 72, right? And we're about to slow this one down, right? So if we're slowing this one down, I would probably want to go up on this to sync it because it's half. So that when you do, you really speeding up because it has to get back to that 70. Then I would take this down to meet over here. Does that make sense?

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: Yeah. So from that, because it moves like that, I wouldn't even sync it. I would just get myself range to get down there.
